# glpi_peripheral (Resource)

GLPI peripheral asset.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "glpi_manufacturer" "logitech" {
  name = "Logitech"
}

resource "glpi_peripheral" "keyboard" {
  name            = "keyboard-01"
  serial          = "KB-0001"
  manufacturer_id = glpi_manufacturer.logitech.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the item.

### Optional

- `brand` (String) Brand of the peripheral.
- `comment` (String) Free-form comment.
- `contact` (String) Contact person.
- `entity_id` (Number) ID of the entity that owns the item. 0 is the root entity.
- `location_id` (Number) ID of the location.
- `manufacturer_id` (Number) ID of the manufacturer.
- `model_id` (Number) ID of the item model.
- `otherserial` (String) Inventory number.
- `serial` (String) Serial number.
- `state_id` (Number) ID of the status.
- `type_id` (Number) ID of the item type.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) GLPI numeric ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by GLPI numeric ID.
terraform import glpi_peripheral.example 42
```
